passages.title: Updated travel reimbursement
passages.text:
MEMO
To: All sales staff
From: Finance Department
Date: November 10
Subject: Updated travel reimbursement

Starting January 1, employees must submit expense reports within 14 days of returning from a trip. Reports submitted later will be processed only with approval from a department head.

Meals are reimbursed up to $55 per day. Receipts are required for any single expense over $20.

Employees should book flights through the company's travel portal. Tickets bought elsewhere will be reimbursed only at the portal's price for the same flight. Hotel rates above $180 per night require advance approval.

why.vi: Tiêu đề và nội dung đều là quy định hoàn chi phí đi công tác.
why.en: The subject and content concern travel reimbursement rules.

questions.q: What is required for a $25 taxi fare?

why.vi: Mọi khoản chi lẻ trên $20 đều cần hóa đơn; $25 vượt $20.
why.en: Receipts are required for any single expense over $20, and $25 is over $20.

questions.trap: Phê duyệt của trưởng phòng chỉ cần khi nộp báo cáo trễ hạn.

questions.q: An employee buys a $420 ticket outside the portal. The portal price for the same flight is $380. How much will probably be reimbursed?

why.vi: Vé mua ngoài cổng chỉ được hoàn theo giá của cổng cho cùng chuyến bay: $380.
why.en: Tickets bought elsewhere are reimbursed only at the portal price, which is $380.

questions.trap: Chọn $420 là bỏ qua quy định mức hoàn bằng giá của cổng đặt vé.
